title: Great experience testing the best acorn feed ham!
text:
Great experience! Highly advisable!!!
The guide was amazing. Absolute knowledge about la boqueria market. 
The visit to the ham drying rooms was amazing. We could see thousands hof pieces drying and taste some Iberian acorn feed ham with cheese and cava. 
We would repeat over and over again!
Thx to Sergio for his great job!!!
author: Trek56540558153

title: Fantastic experience! The product is great! The people are better!
text:
If you have seen the Iberico hams in the Barcelona markets and restaurants, you must take this tour!

More than a tour, this experience is the personal story of the people that produce the hams, a look into the heart of local food production, and a taste of a product that is closer to art than food. 

Sergio, our guide, is not really a guide. He is a third generation pig farmer, pork processor, and owner of an Iberico ham processing company who is providing the highest quality Iberico hams to all the local markets.  He and his family are ham artists at the top of their game.
